_how_to_use: Copy this file, fill in your shop, and start Sabi with SHOP_FILE=path/to/your_shop.json. Money is in kobo (₦12,500 = 1250000). Sabi can also learn the shop info from your links: send it your website or Instagram on WhatsApp, or open ⚙ in the owner app.
